venue.title: Plan your arrival.
venue.description: Find Essentia Luxury Hotel, the DevFest Indore 2026 venue, with directions, check-in information and an entry checklist.
venue.lead: Find Essentia Luxury Hotel and prepare for check-in.
venue.supportText: Ask the organizers about accessibility, parking or other arrival needs before you travel.
venue.entrySummary: Bring your QR ticket and an original physical government-issued photo ID matching your registration. Check any additional requirements for your pass.

steps.text: Ask your campus or community’s DevFest ambassador about the programme and how to register.
